title: VERDICT: Multi-Agent Parallel Modular Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.29147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deductive verification scales to large software systems through modular reasoning, where formal contracts summarize the behavior of individual functions and enable their independent verification. Its central bottleneck is specification synthesis: constructing the contracts required for modular verification. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled automated specification synthesis at unprecedented scale. However, existing approaches remain fundamentally bottom-up, requiring callees to be verified before their callers. This dependency limits parallelism and provides no principled mechanism for resolving interprocedural inconsistencies that propagate across call chains.   We present VERDICT, a multi-agent framework for parallelizing modular deductive verification of large-scale programs. VERDICT is built on two key principles. translated_title: VERDICT：多智能体并行模块化验证
translated_abstract: 演绎验证通过模块化推理扩展到大型软件系统，其中形式化契约总结单个函数的行为，使其能够独立验证。其核心瓶颈在于规范综合：即构建模块化验证所需的契约。大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使自动化规范综合达到了前所未有的规模。然而，现有方法在根本上仍是自底向上的，要求被调用函数必须先于其调用者完成验证。这种依赖关系限制了并行性，且缺乏一种有原则的机制来解决沿调用链传播的过程间不一致性问题。我们提出了VERDICT，一个用于并行化大规模程序模块化演绎验证的多智能体框架。VERDICT建立在两个关键原则之上。首先，基于假设的并行规范综合为每个函数分配一个智能体，并……
tldr: VERDICT是一个多智能体框架，通过基于假设的并行规范综合打破传统自底向上验证的依赖顺序，实现大规模程序模块化演绎验证的并行化。
en_tdlr: VERDICT is a multi-agent framework that parallelizes modular deductive verification of large-scale programs by replacing the traditional bottom-up verification dependency with assumption-based parallel specification synthesis.
